description: PHP class 'HTMLPurifier_Generator' responsible for generating HTML from tokens, including handling of script tags, attributes, and optional tidy formatting.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Generator
classes.description: Class for generating HTML output from tokens, with options for XHTML, script handling, and tidy formatting.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the generator with configuration and context, setting options for script comments, attribute sorting, and doctype.

methods.name: generateFromTokens
methods.description: Generates HTML from an array of tokens, with optional tidy formatting and newline normalization.

methods.name: generateFromToken
methods.description: Generates HTML for a single token, handling start, end, empty, text, and comment tokens.

methods.name: generateScriptFromToken
methods.description: Special processing for script tag contents, wrapping in CDATA and comment tags.

methods.name: generateAttributes
methods.description: Creates HTML attribute string from an attribute array, considering minimization and sorting.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes a string for HTML output using htmlspecialchars.
